attackers_goals: The attacker is attempting to gain an initial foothold in the domain using a list of valid users and a guessed password.
description: The endpoint failed an unusual number of Kerberos pre-authentications (TGT requests) from at least three users when compared to its baseline. This can indicate a password-spraying attack.
investigative_actions: Verify whether the host that generated the alert is normally used by many users (for example, a terminal server). Verify any later authentication success for the user accounts referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.
name: Kerberos Pre-Auth Failures by Host
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs
